def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    s = input[1]

    result = []
    remaining = list(s)

    for i in range(n):
        median_pos = (len(remaining) + 1) // 2 - 1
        result.append(remaining[median_pos])
        del remaining[median_pos]

    print(''.join(result))

main()
